findings.reason: the followup is the plan's next-step pointer, so it must name an unlanded node (§8 or §12); as written it directs the next dispatch at already-shipped work and mis-states which sections are ready.
findings.text: the plan's open driving followup f-lmr-005 declares `data-recommends-skill="/reckon-build lane-and-model-routing §9"` and its prompt (line 170) is `/reckon-build lane-and-model-routing §9`, but §9 is declared `done` (plan-section-declarations s9=done) and landed at 2026-10-08T09:35, and the followup was written at 2026-10-08 10:00, after that landing; its body (line 169) likewise says "§9 and §11 can start now" though both have landed, while the sections actually still implementable are §8 and §12 — a coordinator following this one-line invocation would re-dispatch completed work

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — every cited file (reckon/_backends.py _DIALECTS, reckon/flight.py _record_provenance/_leaf_paths/expand_lanes/LANE_MODEL_KEYS/provenance_sources, reckon/crew/picker/prompts.py option_key, docs/ui/plan.jsx, tests/test_flight.py#test_default_stdout_parses_as_json_and_exits_zero) and every cross-plan anchor (one-typesafe-model-picker #s6/#s10/#s12/#s19, every-module-fits-a-worker-window #s4) resolves; the archive carries ids s1,s2,s3,s5,s6,s7,s9,s11 matching the landed set.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — every implementable section (§4, §8, §10, §12) carries a done-when whose assertion fails on the unfixed code (the §8 key-collision and the §12 leaf-rule assertions were both reproduced against the live resolver), and §4/§12 also state an explicit negative control.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — gate evidence and landed records sit under docs/evidence/ (docs/evidence/archive/lane-and-model-routing-landed.html and docs/evidence/fragments/lane-and-model-routing/), durable in-repo paths, not a scratchpad.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the plan's target symbols are named by mechanism (resolve_name, expand_lanes, option_key, _leaf_paths, LANE_MODEL_KEYS, provenance_sources); no plan label, stage name, ticket number or version tag reaches code. Section-id references appear only in the plan's own prose, which is the tracker.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — all three checks hold: the stated root causes match the evidence (option_key still returns `f"{lane}:{model}"` and still collapses in the questions mapping; _record_provenance still holds its own leaf traversal separate from _leaf_paths; the "0 references in reckon/ and skills/" claim for the four duplicate backend names is measured true), each mechanism produces its done-when, and each mechanism runs on a named production caller (option_key is called by build_questions and picker/__init__; _record_provenance via expand_lanes; flight_report serves the payload).
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — each section names one deliverable in one module family; §8's two items are two properties of one function's key contract, closed by one verdict.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — the open driving followup f-lmr-005 resolves its recommends-skill and prompt to §9, which the plan itself declares landed.
